Frequently Asked Questions.

Everything you need to know about our taxi services, billing, and booking process. Honest answers to help you plan your Udaipur trip perfectly.

Pricing & Bookings

Outstation trips are calculated based on a minimum of 250 KM per day. The total fare includes the per KM rate of your chosen vehicle plus a daily driver allowance (₹300/day). Tolls, parking, and state taxes are paid by the customer as per actual receipts.
